messages:
Samantha (Support): akira from acme-corp emailed — their Android embedded dashboard shows ghost legend entries and several tiles with no data (blank) while other tiles show metrics. tooltips pick the wrong series when you tap. started around 2026-03-15 14:32 UTC. they also saw some 502s in console. attaching screenshots: https://redwood-support-uploads/acme/IMG_20260315_1434.png
Alex Rivera: on it. can you paste repro steps + any request ids or trace ids you got from the console? cc @Jon @Maya :eyes:
Samantha (Support): repro steps from customer: 1) open embedded dashboard in Chrome on Android 12 (webview embed) 2) switch to last 6h range 3) scroll to compact panel view 4) tap legend entries to toggle series 5) observe ghost entries + blank tiles. Customer also pasted a console error: `GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics/query 502 (Bad Gateway)` trace-id: t-0a9f3c4e. They saw it ~14:32 and again ~14:38.
Jon Patel: can you share the raw response headers/body when they got 502? 502 could be upstream timeout or partial selector causing null deref in renderer. also check metrics-ingest backlog around that time.
Samantha (Support): they pasted this curl (redacted org id):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \n  -d '{"query":"series(query)","range":"6h","org_id":4321}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics/query
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
x-trace-id: t-0a9f3c4e
{ "error": "upstream timeout", "details": "partial series returned" }
```
Alex Rivera: thanks. i'm checking the API logs for t-0a9f3c4e. initial look — gateway reported a 504 to the metrics service at that time, but gateway returned 502 to the client.
Maya Chen: fyi i was able to reproduce layout/tooltip mismatch on an Android emulator (Pixel 5, Chrome). when panels are in compact mode the legend container gets overflow:hidden + transform: translateZ(0) and some items render off-canvas but still clickable — that explains ghost entries. suspected regression from frontend change `compact-legend-optim` merged 2 days ago. small repro: open devtools -> toggle device toolbar -> toggle compact mode.
Sam O'Neill: metrics team saw a partial backlog on ingestion at ~14:30–14:38 — kafka consumer lag spiked for the rolling-aggregator consumer (link: https://grafana/metrics/servers?k=rolling-aggregator). ingestion lag peaked ~6m, and we had a small number of partial-window responses where series arrays were truncated. frontend expects either full series or empty array; partial arrays cause the renderer to attempt index mapping and create placeholder legend entries. open ticket: #MET-4721.
metrics-bot: Alert MET-4721 created by ingestion-watcher at 2026-03-15T14:40:12Z. consumer_lag: 540s peak.
Jon Patel: okay — two issues then: upstream ingestion lag caused partial series -> API forwarded partial arrays + gateway timeouts -> client 502s. frontend regression then shows ghost legend/tooltips when partial arrays present. i can add a defensive check in metrics API to normalize partial arrays to nulls and return 200 with `partial=true` header so frontend can show placeholders instead of creating phantom legend items.
Alex Rivera: agreed. quick mitigation we can roll in next 30m: 1) metrics team toggle `normalize_partial_series` flag (hot-config) 2) temporary org-level feature flag `legacy-legend-mode` so embeds for affected orgs fall back to legacy rendering. sam, can you enable for acme-corp?
Sam O'Neill: enabling normalize flag now for all API nodes — patch applied to canaries. kafka backlog is draining; ingestion lag down to <30s.
Samantha (Support): acme-corp confirmed after we enabled legacy-legend-mode for their org the blank tiles and ghost legends stopped appearing. they still saw a single 502 at 14:32 but nothing since. customer happy for now, asks for ETA on permanent fix.
Maya Chen: i'll revert the compact-legend-optim change on canary (quick revert PR) to avoid other customers hitting this while we ship the defensive API change. will open PR and request fast-track review.
Jon Patel: i'll implement the API normalization + `partial=true` header and add unit tests. target: ship in next deploy 2h.
Alex Rivera: i'll coordinate release notes and postmortem blurb for incidents channel. also add a small analytic to log `partial_series_count` so we can alert earlier.
Samantha (Support): thanks team — passing notes to acme-corp that we have a hotfix and a permanent fix in flight. closing this support thread once Jon confirms prod deploy. :thumbsup:
Jon Patel: prod deploy done — normalization live, partial_series alerting ON. monitoring for 1h.
Samantha (Support): acme-corp confirmed everything looks normal now. closing from support side. thanks all! :tada:
